external_crosschecks.evidence: multireference treatment of sequential S-F bonding and recoupled-pair hypercoordination

parity_reduction.finding: For neutral centres with monovalent odd-electron ligands, the +2 coordination sequence preserves the closed-shell electron-count parity and is therefore not by itself an independent new physical law.
parity_reduction.consequence: The previously proposed all-integer d0..d* null is rejected as too weak because it mixes paired closed-shell candidates with odd-electron/radical coordination numbers.
parity_reduction.epistemic_effect: v0.5 is downgraded to structured reorganization bookkeeping until shell bounds or an independent ranking observable outperform a parity-matched null.

revised_model_comparison.M1: M0 plus shell-derived d0/d* bounds and n>=3 admission gate
revised_model_comparison.M2: M1 plus independently defined ranking observable
revised_model_comparison.promotion_condition: M1 or M2 must outperform M0 on frozen held-out energetic/structural targets
